decision: Reuse trailing-actions and inner-padding for Collapsible; approve disclosure-presence and disclosure-motion as distinct conventions.

evidence.channel: Approved Collapsible v0.5 amendment and parent implementation task
evidence.ownerDelegation: Apply the recommendations and merge the PRs, as recorded in odd/tasks/collapsible-actions.md L1 and the approved amendment's Approval section.
evidence.interpretation: The amendment expressly approves its new naming conventions under owner delegation. This is not independent review or visual approval.

convention.name: presence
convention.meaning: Lifetime of a disclosed subtree when its disclosure is closed.
convention.whenToUse: Choose whether disclosed content unmounts or remains mounted while closed, as defined by the component.
convention.avoid: Visibility state, raw Radix forceMount or animation controls.

convention.name: motion
convention.meaning: Opt out of movement on a disclosure trigger and its decorative caret.
convention.whenToUse: Choose the component default movement or suppress the disclosure trigger and caret movement.
convention.avoid: Open state, general animation playback or compact presentation.
